description: This file contains functions for managing LEDs, including retrieving LED device paths, setting LED attributes, and controlling LED blinking patterns such as on, off, heartbeat, and various blink speeds. It appears to be part of the OpenWrt embedded Linux project, providing hardware control routines for device LEDs.

methods.name: get_dt_led_path
methods.description: Retrieves the device tree LED path based on a LED identifier.

methods.name: get_dt_led_color_func
methods.description: Determines the LED color label or function based on device tree properties.

methods.name: get_dt_led
methods.description: Gets the label for a specified LED, combining device tree info and color/function data.

methods.name: led_set_attr
methods.description: Sets a specific attribute of a given LED by writing to sysfs.

methods.name: led_timer
methods.description: Configures a timer trigger with on/off delays for an LED.

methods.name: led_on
methods.description: Turns the LED on by setting brightness to maximum.

methods.name: led_off
methods.description: Turns the LED off by setting brightness to zero.

methods.name: status_led_restore_trigger
methods.description: Restores the default trigger for a status LED based on device tree data.

methods.name: status_led_set_timer
methods.description: Sets the LED to blink with specified on/off delays.

methods.name: status_led_set_heartbeat
methods.description: Configures the LED to a heartbeat trigger pattern.

methods.name: status_led_blink_preinit
methods.description: Configures a pre-initialization slow blink pattern.

methods.name: status_led_blink_failsafe
methods.description: Sets a fast blink pattern for failsafe mode.

methods.name: status_led_blink_preinit_regular
methods.description: Configures a regular pre-initialization fast blink pattern.
